entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: , learned counsel for the objector  ORDER

This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
2.

The applicant is in custody since 08.6.2024 in connection with Crime No.194/2024 registered at P.S.-Gadhwa, District-Singrauli (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376(1) and 506 of IPC.
3.
As per the prosecution case, allegations against the present applicant are that at alleged date, time and place he established physical relationship with prosecutrix against her will.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that incident is said to have occurred on 16.01.2024 but FIR has been lodged on 10.5.2024.
Thus, there is delay in lodging the first information report and for which, no explanation has been furnished.
Charge sheet has been filed in the matter.
Prosecutrix is aged about 19 years.
Applicant is in jail since 08.6.2024.
The trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:46107 2 MCRC-35428-2024 bail.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.
6. Learned counsel for the objector submits that if applicant is released on bail then prosecutrix has no objection.
7. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, including nature of the incident, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, first bail application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

8. It is directed that applicant-Ramanugrah @ Chhote Bais be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
9. Certified copy as per rules.
(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE R Ramanugrah @ Chhote Bais vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96538206/
